roadmap.title: Easy collectible and miscellaneous run
roadmap.description: Play the base story on Easy, choose Mia, follow the chronological route for all 18 Easy/Normal Antique Coins, 32 Files, four Videotapes, and 20 Mr. Everywhere statuettes, and clear every area-specific combat achievement before its lockout.

roadmap.title: Combined Easy challenge run
roadmap.description: Finish under four hours while opening the Item Box only at the three forced points and using at most three First Aid Meds; use Steroids for unrestricted healing and load manual saves from the main menu after costly mistakes.

roadmap.title: Madhouse coins and second ending
roadmap.description: Use the Circular Saw earned by the speedrun, collect all 33 Madhouse-only Antique Coins, choose Zoe after mutated Jack, and finish Madhouse to collect the second ending and the stacked Normal completion.

roadmap.title: Banned Footage scenarios
roadmap.description: Build permanent Nightmare unlocks, clear Night Terror, solve Bedroom with all three rats, complete Ethan Must Die, finish the three 21 modes, obtain both Daughters endings, and finish the Jack's 55th Birthday food, time-bonus, and S-rank goals.

roadmap.title: End of Zoe
roadmap.description: Clear Normal, use the unlocked AMG-78a for a Normal no-weapon run and an Extreme Challenge, then finish Joe Must Die; collect the combo and stealth-kill achievements during any run.

roadmap.title: Not a Hero
roadmap.description: Complete Not a Hero on Normal to unlock Professional, then conserve resources, buy cage upgrades with Antique Coins, and finish the Professional run.

achievements.description: Travel to Louisiana.
achievements.summary: Complete the opening drive and leave Ethan's car after arriving in @loc{Louisiana}.

guide.context: This story unlock is automatic and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Watch the opening drive, then follow the road after Ethan leaves the car; the achievement unlocks during the arrival sequence.

achievements.description: Escape from the guest house.
achievements.summary: Defeat @npc{Mia} in the @loc{Guest House attic} and finish the escape sequence.

guide.context: This is an automatic story milestone near the end of the Guest House prologue.

steps.text: Restore power to the Guest House attic, climb upstairs, and defeat Mia with the handgun.
Continue through the following cutscene until the Guest House sequence ends and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Escape to the yard.
achievements.summary: Place the @item{White, Blue, and Red Dog's Heads} in the @loc{Main Hall door}, then step into the Yard.

guide.context: The Dog's Heads are mandatory story keys, so normal progression eventually opens this exit.

steps.text: Obtain the White, Blue, and Red Dog's Heads while exploring the Main House and defeating Jack in the Morgue.
Insert all three Dog's Heads into the north door in the Main Hall, open the door, and walk into the Yard.

achievements.displayName: The Grave Will Out the Truth
achievements.description: Uncover the secret in the old house.
achievements.summary: Use @npc{Marguerite's Lantern} on the @loc{Old House 2F scale door} and collect the D-Series Arm.

guide.context: The Lantern is the counterweight that opens the previously inaccessible child's room beyond the Altar.

steps.text: Defeat mutated Marguerite in the Greenhouse and take her Lantern from the pit.
Return to the Old House 2F Altar, place the Lantern on the scale beside the locked door, and follow the rooms beyond it.
Reach the final room and collect the D-Series Arm to trigger the achievement.

achievements.description: Escape from the Baker family home.
achievements.summary: Defeat mutated @npc{Jack} at the Boathouse, give the remaining serum to Mia or Zoe, and leave by boat.

guide.context: This automatic story milestone occurs after the choice between Mia and Zoe; either choice advances the escape.

steps.text: Use the serum during the mutated Jack fight at the Boathouse and defeat him.
Choose either Mia or Zoe for the remaining serum, then enter the boat and continue until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Escape from the ship.
achievements.summary: Repair the @loc{Wrecked Ship elevator}, rescue Ethan, and enter the Swamp as Ethan.

guide.context: This is the final automatic chapter-transition achievement before the Salt Mine.

steps.text: As Mia, obtain the Power Cable and Fuse, install both in the Wrecked Ship elevator, and reach Ethan.
After the rescue sequence, regain control of Ethan, leave the ship, and enter the Swamp.

achievements.description: Get ending 1.
achievements.summary: Give the remaining serum to @npc{Mia} after mutated Jack, then reach the finale to unlock the Mia ending.

guide.context: The ending achievement is awarded at the finale, not when Ethan makes the Boathouse choice. A manual save before the choice can preserve access to both endings.

steps.text: Make a manual save before the mutated Jack fight or before approaching Mia and Zoe after the fight.
When prompted at the Boathouse, select Mia and use the remaining serum on her.
Continue through the Wrecked Ship and Salt Mine, defeat the final boss, and complete the ending cutscene.

achievements.description: Get ending 2.
achievements.summary: Give the remaining serum to @npc{Zoe} after mutated Jack, then reach the finale to unlock the Zoe ending.

guide.context: The alternate ending still requires completing the remaining Wrecked Ship and Salt Mine chapters. Reloading a pre-choice save avoids replaying the opening two-thirds.

steps.text: Load a manual save made before the serum choice after the mutated Jack fight.
When prompted at the Boathouse, select Zoe and use the remaining serum on her.
Continue to the end of the story, defeat the final boss, and complete the alternate ending cutscene.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Easy.
achievements.summary: Finish the base-game story on @mechanic{Easy difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: Story difficulty achievements stack downward, so Normal or Madhouse also awards the Easy completion.

steps.text: Start the base story on Easy, Normal, or Madhouse and complete every chapter through the final boss and ending.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Normal.
achievements.summary: Finish the base-game story on @mechanic{Normal difficulty} or Madhouse.

guide.context: A Madhouse completion awards both the Normal and Easy difficulty achievements, making a separate Normal run unnecessary.

steps.text: Start the base story on Normal or Madhouse and complete every chapter through the final boss and ending.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Madhouse.
achievements.summary: Unlock and finish the base-game story on @mechanic{Madhouse difficulty}.

guide.context: Madhouse unlocks after one completed story. It rearranges enemies and items, reduces autosaves, requires Cassette Tapes for manual saves, and replaces the 18 normal coins with 33 Madhouse coins.

steps.text: Complete the base story once on Easy or Normal to unlock Madhouse.
Complete the sub-four-hour run first if possible, then take the unlocked Circular Saw from the first Item Box and conserve Cassette Tapes, ammunition, and healing.
Complete every Madhouse chapter and defeat the final boss; the Easy and Normal completion achievements stack if still locked.

achievements.description: Close an open door by yourself.
achievements.summary: Open any normal @loc{door}, face it, and use the interact input to close it manually.

guide.context: Doors that close automatically do not demonstrate the required player action.

steps.text: Open a hinged door, turn back toward it, and press the interact input while the close prompt is available.

achievements.description: Block an enemy attack by guarding.
achievements.summary: Hold @mechanic{Guard} while an enemy attack connects with Ethan.

guide.context: The achievement checks for a blocked impact, so raising Ethan's arms without taking an attack is insufficient.

steps.text: Approach a Molded or another attacking enemy, hold the Guard input before its swing lands, and keep guarding through the impact.

achievements.description: Obtain something by closely examining an item.
achievements.summary: Examine @item{Mia's handbag}, rotate it, and take Mia's Driver's License from inside.

guide.context: The handbag is the earliest guaranteed example; orange boxes containing hidden items work the same way.

steps.text: Before entering the Guest House, look beneath the fallen tree on the approach path and pick up Mia's handbag.
Choose Examine, rotate the handbag until Mia's Driver's License is visible, and take the license.

achievements.description: Use a lock pick to open something.
achievements.summary: Use a @item{Lockpick} on the locked hallway drawer beside the @loc{Main House Laundry Room}.

guide.context: The early Laundry Room Lockpick appears on Easy and Normal, providing a predictable first opportunity.

steps.text: After the Baker dinner, enter the Main House 1F Laundry Room and examine the orange box beside the exit to remove the Lockpick.
Leave the Laundry Room, turn right toward the boarded window, and use the Lockpick on the locked hallway drawer.

achievements.description: Put an unrelated object on a shadow plinth.
achievements.summary: Place any unrelated inventory object on the @loc{Main Hall shadow plinth}.

guide.context: A rejected object is the success condition; the Wooden Statuette that solves the puzzle will not count.

steps.text: Approach the shadow plinth in the Main House Main Hall, open the item selection, and choose an unsuitable object such as an Antique Coin or Chem Fluid.

achievements.description: Use psychostimulants.
achievements.summary: Select and consume any @item{Psychostimulants} from Ethan's inventory.

guide.context: Psychostimulants temporarily highlight nearby items through walls; no discovery is required after taking them.

steps.text: After solving the first shadow puzzle, enter the opened room and take the Psychostimulants from the table behind the large deer.
Open the inventory, select Psychostimulants, and choose Use.

achievements.description: Increase your item slots.
achievements.summary: Pick up the @item{Backpack} in the Old House exterior safe room to add four inventory slots.

guide.context: Any of the three Backpacks unlocks the achievement; later alternatives are in the Main House Master Bedroom closet and Wrecked Ship 1F Recreation Room.

steps.text: Follow the Old House exterior walkway to the safe room containing an Item Box and cassette recorder, then take the Backpack from the table.

achievements.description: Finish off an enemy with the knife.
achievements.summary: Kill one large @enemy{flying insect} in the Old House with the Knife.

guide.context: The large insects resting on walls die to one knife hit; Marguerite's tiny insect swarms do not qualify as the enemy.

steps.text: In the Old House, find a large flying insect resting on a wall, equip the Knife, approach it, and strike until it dies.

achievements.description: Clear insects off a door using a knife.
achievements.summary: Use the @item{Knife} to clear every spider from an infested Old House door or cabinet.

guide.context: The knife stab has longer reach than the normal slash and reduces damage from the spiders.

steps.text: In the Old House, approach a door or green cabinet covered in spiders, equip the Knife, and keep slashing or stabbing until every spider falls away.

achievements.description: Fight off Marguerite while she wanders the old house to make her run away.
achievements.summary: Damage @npc{Marguerite} during her Old House patrol until she abandons the encounter.

guide.context: This opportunity begins after Lucas abducts Mia. Hiding until Marguerite leaves advances the story but does not satisfy the combat check.

steps.text: During Marguerite's Old House patrol, confront her in the hallway or adjacent room instead of hiding.
Shoot Marguerite with the handgun or shotgun, burn the insect swarm with the Burner, and continue damaging her until she retreats.

achievements.description: Avoid Jack's scissor attack by crouching.
achievements.summary: Crouch beneath @npc{Jack's overhead chainsaw-scissor attack} during the Main House Morgue fight.

guide.context: Jack takes the chainsaw scissors only after Ethan deals enough damage in the mandatory fight for the Red Dog's Head.

steps.text: Fight Jack in the Main House B1 Morgue and damage him until he arms himself with the chainsaw scissors.
Stay in front of Jack; when he raises the scissors for the overhead crossing cut, crouch and remain low until both blades pass above Ethan.

achievements.description: Take down two or more enemies with one shot.
achievements.summary: Kill at least two @enemy{Old House insects} with one shotgun blast.

guide.context: Marguerite's summoned swarm provides a dense, repeatable target; two Molded aligned for one shotgun blast or killed by one Remote Bomb also count.

steps.text: During Marguerite's Old House patrol, let her release a compact swarm of small insects.
Aim the shotgun at the center of the swarm and fire once so the same shell kills at least two insects.

achievements.description: Shoot and knock back Marguerite while she's leaping at you.
achievements.summary: Shoot mutated @npc{Marguerite} during a Greenhouse leap and knock her backward in midair.

guide.context: Marguerite briefly clings to a wall or ceiling and recoils before leaping, which gives a readable timing cue.

steps.text: During the Greenhouse boss fight, keep a loaded shotgun ready and watch Marguerite when she climbs onto a wall or ceiling.
As Marguerite recoils and jumps toward Ethan, shoot her center mass before she lands; the achievement appears when the hit knocks her back.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy by attaching a Remote Bomb to them and detonating it.
achievements.summary: Let a two-armed @enemy{Molded} grab Ethan, attach a @item{Remote Bomb}, then detonate it for the kill.

guide.context: Remote Bombs first become plentiful on the Wrecked Ship. Blade-arm Molded do not use the grab needed for the attachment prompt.

steps.text: On the Wrecked Ship, equip a Remote Bomb and approach a standard Molded with both thin arms intact.
Allow the Molded to knock Ethan down and grab him, then use the displayed struggle input to force the Remote Bomb onto its body.
Move clear and activate the detonator; the explosion must kill the attached Molded.

achievements.description: Create all items that contain Chem Fluid and Strong Chem Fluid.
achievements.summary: Craft all eight recipes made with @item{Chem Fluid} or @item{Strong Chem Fluid} in one save.

guide.context: Each combination only needs to be produced once; the resulting item may be used or discarded afterward.

steps.text: Combine regular Chem Fluid separately with Herb, Gunpowder, Supplements, and Solid Fuel to make First Aid Med, Handgun Ammo, Psychostimulants, and Burner Fuel.
Combine Strong Chem Fluid separately with Herb, Gunpowder, Supplements, and Solid Fuel to make Strong First Aid Med, Enhanced Handgun Ammo, Neuro Rounds, and Flame Rounds.

achievements.description: Complete the "Mia" videotape without being spotted by Marguerite.
achievements.summary: Finish the “Mia” videotape without @npc{Marguerite} detecting Mia; accept capture and restart the checkpoint after any sighting.

guide.context: Being caught immediately after detection restarts the tape checkpoint without invalidating the attempt; successfully fleeing after detection does invalidate it.

steps.text: Take the “Mia” videotape from the Main House 2F Recreation Room and play it on the nearby TV.
Move between cover only while Marguerite faces away, stay hidden during each patrol, and complete the tape without entering and escaping her alert state.
If Marguerite spots Mia, stop running and let her catch Mia, then retry from the tape checkpoint.

achievements.description: Complete the "Happy Birthday" videotape within 5 minutes.
achievements.summary: Complete the “Happy Birthday” videotape in under @mechanic{five minutes}.

guide.context: The timer covers the videotape scenario, and the fixed LOSER solution removes the need to experiment with the clown puzzle.

steps.text: Take the Candle, enter the cake room to extinguish it, pull the Winding Key from the keg, flush the toilet for the Dirty Telescope, and clean the telescope in the sprinkler doorway.
View the monitors through the clean telescope, enter their three symbols on the cake-room box, take the Straw Doll, burn it on the stove for the Dummy Finger, and relight the Candle.

Use the lit Candle to sever the side-door rope, collect the Balloon, and place it on the gas pipe to obtain the Quill Pen; fit the clown with the three puzzle parts: Winding Key, Dummy Finger, and Quill Pen.
Enter LOSER on the padlock, take the Valve Handle, shut off the sprinklers, relight the Candle, and place it on the cake before five minutes elapse.

achievements.description: Watch all the videotapes in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Watch @item{Derelict House Footage, Mia, Happy Birthday, and the Old Videotape} during one story run.

guide.context: The Old Videotape is mandatory; Derelict House Footage, Mia, and Happy Birthday must be collected before their story areas become inaccessible.

steps.text: Take “Derelict House Footage” from the Guest House 2F Attic beside the first save point and play it on a TV.
Take “Mia” from the Main House 2F Recreation Room and play it on the TV in the same room.
After obtaining the Snake Key, activate the lamp switch in the Main House 2F Kid's Room, climb into the 3F Attic, take “Happy Birthday” from the cupboard, and play it on a TV.
On the Wrecked Ship, take the Old Videotape from the 3F Security Room and watch the mandatory recording.

achievements.description: Obtain all of the Antique Coins in Easy or Normal difficulty.
achievements.estTime: one Easy or Normal collectible run
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{18 Antique Coins} on Easy or Normal during one story run.

guide.context: Easy/Normal coins form a separate set from the 33 Madhouse coins. Spending a coin preserves collection credit, but deaths and checkpoint rollbacks require recollecting anything found after the last save.

achievements.description: Destroy a Mr. Everywhere statuette.
achievements.summary: Destroy the @item{Mr. Everywhere statuette} in the @loc{Main House Laundry Room}.

guide.context: Any of the 20 statuettes qualifies; the Laundry Room figure is the earliest straightforward target.

steps.text: After the Baker dinner, enter the Main House 1F Laundry Room and shoot or strike the small Mr. Everywhere statuette until it breaks.

achievements.description: Destroy all Mr. Everywhere statuettes.
achievements.summary: Destroy all @item{20 Mr. Everywhere statuettes} across the base story.

guide.context: Destroyed statuettes persist between playthroughs, but the game does not reveal which individual figure remains; one chronological sweep prevents an uncertain cleanup.

collectibles.method: From the Barn floor, look above the fenced catwalk and shoot the statuette perched on its upper rail.

collectibles.name: Monitoring Room doorframe
collectibles.method: Leave the Monitoring Room, turn around, look above its closed door, and shoot the statuette over the doorframe.

collectibles.name: Storage Shack fishing net
collectibles.method: Break the statuette on the floor against the back wall, partly covered by fishing netting beside the shelves.

collectibles.name: Captain's Cabin stair rail
collectibles.method: On the stairs near the Captain's Cabin, break the statuette perched on the right-hand railing at the landing.

collectibles.name: Elevator-shaft crossbeam
collectibles.method: While climbing through the elevator shaft, look above the opening and shoot the statuette on the horizontal crossbeam.

collectibles.name: Swamp Shack mesh wall
collectibles.method: Inside the shack after leaving the Wrecked Ship, shoot the statuette behind the wire-mesh wall beside the overturned cart.

collectibles.name: Cavern barrel platform
collectibles.method: In the Cavern, look up to the metal platform holding two barrels and shoot the statuette at the platform edge.

collectibles.name: Mine Storeroom rack
collectibles.method: Break the final statuette on the middle shelf of the metal rack beside the green tray.

achievements.description: Complete the game within 4 hours.
achievements.summary: Finish the base story with the in-game timer at or below @mechanic{four hours}.

guide.context: Pausing stops the timer, but Retry after a death keeps the failed attempt's time. Loading a manual save from the main menu restores the saved timer.

steps.text: Start on Easy after learning the route, skip optional exploration and videotapes, and take useful completion rewards from the first Item Box.
Make manual saves at cassette recorders; after a slow section or death, quit to the main menu and load the save instead of selecting Retry.
Give the serum to Mia after mutated Jack to avoid the extra ship encounter associated with Zoe's route.
Defeat the final boss and complete the ending before the Statistics timer exceeds four hours.

achievements.description: Complete the game without opening the Item Box more than 3 times.
achievements.summary: Finish the base story after opening the @item{Item Box} no more than three times.

guide.context: The story permits exactly three unavoidable uses. The Item Management screen offered after a boss death does not increase the box counter.

steps.text: Do not open any green Item Box during the Guest House, Main House, Old House, or early Testing Area.
Open the Item Box when Lucas requires Ethan to deposit every carried item before entering the Birthday room.
After escaping the Birthday room, open the Item Box once to recover the Crank and combat equipment for the Boathouse.
After leaving the Wrecked Ship and regaining Ethan's equipment access, open the Swamp Item Box once for the Salt Mine and final boss, then finish without another use.

achievements.description: Complete the game using only 3 First Aid Meds or less.
achievements.summary: Finish the base story after using no more than @item{three First Aid Meds} and no plain Herbs.

guide.context: Steroids restore health without adding to the healing-item counter, making every steroid a safe full heal during this run.

steps.text: Start on Easy, block attacks, run past optional enemies, and make manual saves before each boss.
Use at most three First Aid Meds or Strong First Aid Meds for the entire run, and never consume a plain Herb.
Use any collected Steroids when Ethan needs unrestricted healing, then complete the final boss and ending.

achievements.description: Complete Nightmare.
achievements.summary: Survive all five hourly waves in @mechanic{Banned Footage: Nightmare} until dawn.

guide.context: Failed attempts still award points for permanent scenario unlocks. Compactors stop roughly 40 seconds before each wave ends and resume when the next wave begins.

steps.text: From Extra Content, select Banned Footage, choose Nightmare, and activate the starting Compactors to generate Scrap.
Buy Corrosive early, open both locked Workshop routes, and activate the two additional Compactors before spending heavily on weapons.
Buy ammunition, healing, traps, and damage upgrades between attacks, defeat both Jack boss waves, and remain alive through the fifth hour until dawn.

achievements.description: Complete Night Terror.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Nightmare} once to unlock Night Terror, then survive all five Night Terror waves.

guide.context: Night Terror is the harder Nightmare variant and shares the permanent rewards earned with points from prior failed or completed attempts.

steps.text: Complete Nightmare once to unlock Night Terror, then repeat Nightmare if needed to earn stronger permanent equipment and trap options.
Start Night Terror, activate the Compactors, buy Corrosive early, and open both extra Scrap-production rooms.
Use traps and purchased upgrades to survive every wave and defeat both Jack encounters through the end of hour five.

achievements.description: Complete Bedroom.
achievements.summary: Escape @mechanic{Bedroom}, closing altered furniture and restoring the correct painting before every Marguerite inspection.

guide.context: Marguerite notices altered furniture and the wrong painting. The first failed inspection consumes the scenario's warning; a second capture kills Clancy.

steps.text: Leave the bed between Marguerite's visits, inspect the room and adjoining space for puzzle items, and note each object's original position.
Before the music ends, close every opened drawer or wardrobe, return the correct painting, hide suspicious items, and climb back into bed.
Complete the symbol-lock and sewing puzzles, obtain the Knife, cut the restraint, defend against Marguerite, and leave the room to finish the scenario.

achievements.description: Find all the dead rats in Bedroom in a single play.
achievements.summary: In one @mechanic{Bedroom} attempt, inspect the rats beside the bed, in the second meal bowl, and beyond the symbol lock.

guide.context: The second rat appears only after Marguerite serves the later meal, while the third remains behind the Serpent, Leaf, Apple symbol lock.

collectibles.name: Bedside rat
collectibles.location: Bedroom floor by the barrel and painting
collectibles.method: Leave the bed and inspect the dead rat on the floor beside the bed.

collectibles.name: Meal rat
collectibles.method: Wait for Marguerite's second food delivery, eat from the bowl with the Fork, let Clancy finish vomiting, and examine the bowl once more.

collectibles.name: Adjoining-room rat
collectibles.location: Right shelf beyond the symbol lock
collectibles.method: Set the symbol lock to Serpent, Leaf, Apple, enter the adjoining room, and inspect the rat on the right-side shelf.

achievements.description: Complete Ethan Must Die.
achievements.summary: Reach and defeat @npc{Marguerite} without dying in @mechanic{Ethan Must Die}.

guide.context: Death restarts the scenario, randomized crates change their contents each run, and the angel statue at the death point preserves one random carried item for the next attempt.

steps.text: Move through the fixed enemy route, listen before breaking each crate, and leave any ticking bomb crate intact.
Watch for lethal tripwires, block survivable attacks, avoid optional fights, and reserve the strongest ammunition and healing for the end.
Reach the modified Marguerite encounter and defeat her on the same life to complete Ethan Must Die.

achievements.description: Complete 21.
achievements.summary: Win all three stages of @mechanic{21}, saving “Love Your Enemy” for the final scripted hand.

guide.context: The deck contains one card of each value from 1 through 11. Tracking visible values reveals which draws remain and makes exact-draw trump cards safer.

steps.text: In each hand, track Clancy's cards, the opponent's visible card, and every revealed draw; stop below 21 whenever the remaining deck makes a bust likely.
Use Shields to absorb punishment and draw or sabotage trump cards to force favorable totals, but keep “Love Your Enemy” unused through the first two stages.
During the third stage's forced final situation, play “Love Your Enemy” so the opponent draws the required best card, then win the hand and finish the scenario.

achievements.description: Complete Survival mode in 21.
achievements.summary: Defeat all @mechanic{five opponents} in 21 Survival without losing the single run.

guide.context: Survival has no checkpoint between opponents. Deck knowledge and preserved trump cards matter more than winning any single hand quickly.

steps.text: Track the unique 1–11 cards every hand and use the opponent's face-up card to estimate the hidden total.
Save Shields, exact-draw cards, and high damage multipliers for hands where a loss would remove several lives.
Defeat five consecutive opponents before Clancy's life total reaches zero.

achievements.displayName: You Gotta Know When To Hold 'Em
achievements.description: Complete Survival+ mode in 21.
achievements.summary: Defeat all @mechanic{ten opponents} in 21 Survival+ without losing the single run.

guide.context: A loss against any opponent restarts all ten. Permanent trump-card unlocks from earlier 21 play improve the available deck.

steps.text: Complete 21 and Survival, then earn useful trump-card unlocks before committing to Survival+.
Count the 1–11 deck, protect uncertain hands with Shields, and combine damage multipliers with forced-draw cards when an opponent is vulnerable.
Defeat all ten opponents consecutively without exhausting Clancy's life total.

achievements.description: Get the bad ending in Daughters.
achievements.summary: In @mechanic{Daughters}, do not enter the attic or use Lucas' laptop; take the normal escape route for the bad ending.

guide.context: The normal objective route deliberately bypasses the hidden laptop steps required for the true ending.

steps.text: Follow each displayed objective, do not use the Small Component on the Kid's Room trophy, and do not access Lucas' attic laptop.
Use the ordinary escape route presented by the scenario and continue through its final cutscene to receive the bad ending.

achievements.description: Get the true ending in Daughters.
achievements.summary: Use code @mechanic{1019}, recover the red-box Dog's Head, and enter the Trailer for Daughters' true ending.

guide.context: Lucas reveals 1019 on his phone in the kitchen. The hidden laptop route must be activated before the scenario advances beyond the Baker house objectives.

steps.text: Watch Lucas enter 1019 on his phone, then enter the crawlspace through the Laundry Room and take the Lockpick at the far end.
Use the Lockpick on the Bathroom drawer for the Small Component, then install it in the trophy in the Kid's Room to open the attic.
Climb into the attic, open Lucas' laptop, and enter 1019.
Continue until Zoe removes the boarded-window screws with the Fork, climb outside, squeeze through the opening at the end of the path, and take the Dog's Head from the red box.
Return to the Main Hall, use the Dog's Head on the three-headed door, cross the Yard, and enter the Trailer to trigger the true ending.

achievements.description: Clear a stage with a 10 minute time bonus or higher in Jack's 55th Birthday.
achievements.summary: Finish one @mechanic{Jack's 55th Birthday} stage after earning at least ten minutes of bonus time.

guide.context: Damaging and killing enemies adds bonus time independently of the countdown. Main House 2 provides enough targets for a controlled attempt.

steps.text: Choose Main House 2 and equip Speed II, Brawler, Time Bonus α-1, Time Bonus β-1, and the Golden Crowbar when those skills are available.
Follow the enemy route, attack every group, and keep collecting the displayed time awards until the cumulative bonus reaches at least 10:00.
Deliver enough food to fill Jack's satisfaction meter and finish the stage without losing the accumulated ten-minute bonus.

achievements.description: Feed Jack every type of food and drink in Jack's 55th Birthday.
achievements.summary: Feed @npc{Jack} the drinks Beer, Cheap Wine, and Dulvey Cru; the foods Cake, Cheese, Chicken, Fruit, Garbage, Spice, Stew, and Sugar; plus Baker Family Special, Cheese Fondue, Cheesecake, Fruit Beer, Fruit Cake, Spicy Chicken, Sugar Cake, and Tom Yum.

guide.context: Each base ingredient must be served alone as well as used in its recipes; progress can be spread across stage attempts.

collectibles.name: Beer
collectibles.method: Bring one Beer to Jack without combining it.

collectibles.name: Cake
collectibles.method: Bring one Cake to Jack without combining it.

collectibles.name: Cheap Wine
collectibles.method: Bring one Cheap Wine to Jack.

collectibles.name: Cheese
collectibles.method: Bring one Cheese to Jack without combining it.

collectibles.name: Chicken
collectibles.method: Bring one Chicken to Jack without combining it.

collectibles.name: Dulvey Cru
collectibles.method: Bring one Dulvey Cru to Jack.

collectibles.name: Fruit
collectibles.method: Bring one Fruit to Jack without combining it.

collectibles.name: Garbage
collectibles.method: Bring one Garbage to Jack without combining it.

collectibles.name: Spice
collectibles.method: Bring one Spice to Jack without combining it.

collectibles.name: Stew
collectibles.method: Bring one Stew to Jack without combining it.

collectibles.name: Sugar
collectibles.method: Bring one Sugar to Jack without combining it.

collectibles.name: Baker Family Special
collectibles.method: Combine Garbage with Sugar and feed the result to Jack.

collectibles.name: Cheese Fondue
collectibles.method: Combine Cheese with Stew and feed the result to Jack.

collectibles.name: Cheesecake
collectibles.method: Combine Cheese with Cake and feed the result to Jack.

collectibles.name: Fruit Beer
collectibles.method: Combine Beer with Fruit and feed the result to Jack.

collectibles.name: Fruit Cake
collectibles.method: Combine Fruit with Cake and feed the result to Jack.

collectibles.name: Spicy Chicken
collectibles.method: Combine Chicken with Spice and feed the result to Jack.

collectibles.name: Sugar Cake
collectibles.method: Combine Sugar with Cake and feed the result to Jack.

collectibles.name: Tom Yum
collectibles.method: Combine Spice with Stew and feed the result to Jack.

achievements.description: Get an S Rank or higher on all stages in Jack's 55th Birthday.
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{S rank or better} on Guest House 1, Testing Area 1, Main House 1, Guest House 2, Testing Area 2, and Main House 2.

guide.context: Earlier ranks unlock stronger weapons and skills for later maps. Combined foods fill Jack more efficiently, while key-marked enemies open matching colored doors.

steps.text: Clear the available stages repeatedly to unlock stronger weapons, movement skills, Brawler, and time-bonus skills.
Memorize each food and enemy route, kill key-marked Molded to open color-matched doors, and keep damaging enemies to pause or extend the countdown.
Combine ingredients into high-value recipes before returning to Jack so each delivery raises satisfaction efficiently.
Finish each of the six stages with the results screen showing S, SS, or a higher qualifying rank.

achievements.description: Complete End of Zoe on Easy or Normal.
achievements.summary: Reach the ending of @mechanic{End of Zoe} while playing on Easy or Normal.

guide.context: Normal is the useful first clear because it unlocks Joe Must Die, the AMG-78a, and Extreme Challenges needed for later achievements.

steps.text: Start End of Zoe on Normal, punch or stealth-kill Molded, and use Throwing Spears to eliminate alligators from safe range.
Follow the story through the paddle boat, steamboat, and final Jack encounter, then complete the ending.

achievements.description: Complete End of Zoe on Joe Must Die.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{End of Zoe} on Normal once to unlock Joe Must Die, then finish Joe Must Die.

guide.context: Joe Must Die adds bomb crates, tripwires, stronger enemies, Cassette Tape saves, and fewer autosaves. The AMG-78a from the first clear remains allowed and is the key upgrade.

steps.text: Complete End of Zoe on Normal to unlock Joe Must Die and the AMG-78a, then equip the gauntlet for the new run.
Listen for ticking before breaking crates, disarm or avoid tripwires, collect Cassette Tapes, and save before difficult encounters.
Use charged AMG-78a punches, environmental traps, and conserved healing to defeat every required enemy and the final Jack fight.

achievements.description: Complete End of Zoe on Normal or Joe Must Die using no weapons.
achievements.estTime: one Normal run after AMG unlock
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{End of Zoe on Normal} without firing, throwing, or detonating any weapon.

guide.context: Bare fists, the AMG-78a, and Dual AMG are allowed melee attacks. Joe Must Die is unsuitable because mandatory barrel obstacles require a thrown weapon and invalidate the run.

steps.text: Complete End of Zoe once to unlock the AMG-78a, then start a new run on Normal and equip the gauntlet.
Use only bare fists, stealth attacks, the AMG-78a, or Dual AMG; weapons may be picked up, but do not fire a Shotgun, throw a Spear or Knife, or deploy a bomb.
Kill required Molded and alligators with melee attacks, complete the final Jack fight, and reach the ending without any prohibited weapon use.

achievements.description: Complete an Extreme Challenge in End of Zoe.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{End of Zoe} once to unlock Extreme Challenges, then complete any one Extreme Challenge.

guide.context: Extreme Challenges appear only after the first End of Zoe completion. The first challenge on Normal has the simplest objective and enemy route.

steps.text: Complete End of Zoe once, then begin another Normal run and open the challenge list from the inventory journal.
Activate the first Extreme Challenge and kill every marked enemy before its countdown reaches zero.

achievements.description: Perform a 4-hit combo with your bare fists in End of Zoe.
achievements.summary: Strike the hanging practice corpse outside Joe's cabin with @mechanic{Right, Left, Right, Left} punches.

guide.context: The practice corpse is available immediately and demonstrates the two alternating punch inputs before combat begins.

steps.text: Leave Joe's starting cabin, approach the upside-down corpse hanging from the tree, and land the four-hit bare-fist chain Right, Left, Right, Left without breaking the sequence.

achievements.description: Stealth kill 5 enemies in End of Zoe.
achievements.estTime: during one End of Zoe run
achievements.summary: Perform @mechanic{five stealth kills} on unaware Molded during End of Zoe.

guide.context: Normal difficulty provides enough isolated Molded, and the kills can be accumulated throughout one complete run.

steps.text: Crouch before entering a Molded's sight line, approach directly behind the unaware enemy, and use the displayed stealth-kill attack.
Repeat the rear stealth attack on separate Molded until the fifth kill registers.

achievements.description: Complete Not a Hero on Easy or Normal difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Not a Hero} campaign on Easy or Normal difficulty.

guide.context: A completion on either Easy or Normal unlocks Professional, so this clear is the required setup for the final difficulty achievement.

steps.text: From Extra Content, start Not a Hero on Normal, complete the three gas-filter routes, survive Lucas' traps, and defeat mutated Lucas.

achievements.description: Complete Not a Hero on Professional difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{Not a Hero} once on either Easy or Normal; when Professional unlocks, clear the campaign again on Professional.

guide.context: Professional unlocks after one Not a Hero completion. Antique Coins purchase cage upgrades that improve survival against its two hardest boss encounters.

steps.text: Complete Not a Hero once on Easy or Normal, then start a new Not a Hero run on Professional.
Conserve ammunition and First Aid, collect Antique Coins, and spend them on useful cage upgrades before the late encounters.
Defeat the Fat Molded guarding the liquid-nitrogen canister, survive Lucas' remaining traps, and kill mutated Lucas to complete Professional.
